title: Create and rename a folder
goal: Create a new folder on the Desktop and give it a name

milestones.goal: Open a Finder window showing the Desktop
milestones.done_when: A Finder window is open with Desktop selected in its sidebar
hints: Click the Finder icon in the Dock

milestones.done_when: A folder named 'untitled folder' appears with its name ready to edit
milestones.teach: Shift+Command+N works in any Finder window.

milestones.done_when: The new folder shows the name the learner typed (not 'untitled folder')
hints: Type the name while it is highlighted, then press Return
